description: Probe-only rejection library for hipkernel:Gfx1151WmmaAttention (the prefill engine of the rocKE RDNA attention pack, forward SDPA, gfx1151; the 48 objects of descriptors/rocKE/gfx1151_wmma_attention/gfx1151_wmma_attention.kdp.json: FP16 or BF16, the (head_size, head_size_v) buckets 64/64, 96/96, 128/128, 192/128, 256/128 and 256/256 (the last three also with block_m 64), bias none, f32 or q, mask class 'causal' that also expresses no mask): a legal graph the engine ships (BSHD, bf16 or half, a (Hq, Hkv) pair, a shipped head-size pair, seqlen_q above 64 with batch * Hq >= 12, scale 0.0883883, declared alignment 16) with ONE feature per case, named by the `family` axis (the base shape is the `shape` axis, a [dtype, B, Hq, Hkv, Sq, Skv, head size, head size V] tuple; the `alt` axis is 8 tuples that carry each family's own values, one field per family group: [0] odd seqlen_q, [1] odd seqlen_kv, [2] head sizes not a multiple of 8, [3] unshipped head sizes, [4] head sizes above 256, [5] V widths not a multiple of 8, [6] V widths above 256, [7] unshipped (Q/K, V) pairs, [8] short seqlen_q, [9] the few-CTA [B, Hq, Hkv, Sq] tuples, [10] the [Sq, Q/K, V] widths of the decode-bucket gap, [11] the GQA head pairs, [12] the bias row pad, [13] the low declared alignments [Q/K/V/O, LSE, FP32 bias, Q-dtype bias], [14] the overflow dims [name, B, Hq, Hkv, Sq, Skv, head size, head size V]); every family is a graph the frontend accepts. Authored on a gfx1151 device (Radeon 8060S) but NOT yet run: every expectation below is what Gfx1151WmmaAttentionNative.cpp says, not an observed outcome; the engine needs HIPDNN_ENABLE_KERNEL_INGESTOR, HIPKERNELPROVIDER_ENABLE_ROCKE and -DGPU_TARGETS=gfx1151. `expect` is `declined` where the engine's code must not take the graph (the kernels have no input for the feature or the matcher states the limit, so an accept computes something else) and `declined_or_pass` where a correct engine may take it and a reference can check it (then it must be right). Lines cited are in dnn-providers/hip-kernel-provider/src/engines/kernel_ingestor_engine/packs/Gfx1151WmmaAttentionNative.cpp unless a file is named; gfx1151WmmaAttentionGraphMatches (673-841, the graph matcher both Gfx1151 engines share) and kernelMatchesFor (1128-1167) are the two gates. PREFILL VERSUS DECODE: rdnaAttentionUseDecode (234-256) sends a graph to decode on gfx11 (not gfx12, so the gfx12 branch 250-253 does not apply) when seqlen_q <= 64 and (Hq/Hkv * Sq < 512 or the visible keys < 64 * CUs or batch * visible keys < 512 * CUs), or when seqlen_q > 64 and 4 * batch * Hq * ceil(Sq/128) < CUs (visible keys = hi - lo of decodeKvRange, 215-225; CUs = twice HIP's multiProcessorCount, 264-267 and 1097), and usesDecode (1087-1099) also needs a decode bucket (decodeBucket, 197-212: max(Q/K, V) head size up to 64, 128 or 256, with Q/K at least 16, 72 or 136). kernelMatchesFor declines for the prefill engine every graph catalogDecodePlan (1107-1124, decodePlanFor 1032-1084) admits (1158-1162); the families draw only shapes that route the same way at 32 and at 40 compute units (a decode route at 32 is one at 40, a prefill route at 40 is one at 32): every base shape has batch * Hq >= 12, so any seqlen_q above 64 is prefill. The space declares no constraints (they made the pairwise search too slow); instead every shape x alt combination of every family was checked off line: the decode families route to decode at 32 and 40 CUs, every other family to prefill at both, the fallback family has no decode bucket, Hq is divisible by Hkv and by Hv, and the oracle cost b * hq * sq * skv * max(head sizes) stays at or under 2**31 (the pairwise lower bound also asks every axis to have at most as many levels as `shape`). decode_small_sq (seqlen_q 1 to 64 on a base shape whose key length is at most 512, so the visible keys stay under 64 * 32), decode_few_ctas (seqlen_q above 64 with at most 7 query CTAs: batch * Hq * ceil(Sq/128) <= 7, alt field 9), decode_causal_long_kv (Sq 64, Skv 4096, Hq 16, Hkv 2, top-left causal: the keys any row sees are the first 64 whatever Skv is, so the visible keys are 64 and the graph is decode despite the long key length) and decode_window_long_kv (the same with a bottom-right window, left_bound 256 and right_bound 0: 319 visible keys of 4096): all `declined`, the decode engine's graphs (SdpaFwd/Gfx1151Decode draws them). small_sq_prefill_fallback: seqlen_q 1 to 64 where decodeBucket finds no bucket (Q/K width below 16, 72 or 136 for the bucket of the widths, alt field 10: 8/8, 64/128, 128/256, 8/64, 64/256, 24/128, 16/136, 40/200), so usesDecode is false and the prefill engine takes it (a prefill object serves any width up to its bucket, 1163-1166): declined_or_pass. SHAPE: none: control, a plain graph the engine takes. odd_sq (seqlen_q 65 to 255, not a multiple of the 128-row CTA tile) and odd_skv (1, 3, 31, 33, 63, 100, 129, 255): the lengths are runtime kernel arguments and the matcher asks nothing of them: declined_or_pass. head_not_vector (head size 1, 4, 12, 36, 63, 100, 132, 260 for Q, K, V and O): isServedHeadDim (503-507) asks a multiple of 8 from 8 to 256 (HEAD_DIM_GRANULE and MAX_HEAD_DIM, 150-151), line 696-697: `declined`. head_over_max (264, 288, 320, 384, 512): above MAX_HEAD_DIM, same line: `declined`. v_head_not_vector (V and O 1, 4, 12, 36, 63, 100, 132, 260 under a shipped Q/K width) and v_head_over_max (V and O 264 to 512): line 697, `declined`. head_unshipped (8, 24, 72, 80, 112, 136, 160, 248 for Q, K, V and O, multiples of 8 the catalog has no pair of) and v_head_unshipped ((Q/K, V/O) 64/128, 128/64, 96/192, 256/64, 128/256, 64/256, 192/256, 96/64: no shipped pair, and 64/128 and 96/192 are V wider than the pair's V bucket, so the (128,128) and (256,256) objects take them): a prefill object serves any widths up to its bucket (1163-1166, runtime head_dim_q and head_dim_v, signature 1265-1294): declined_or_pass. kv_heads_differ: V with another head count than K, both dividing Hq (which the frontend allows, SdpaFwdNode.hpp:129-152); the matcher takes it (Hq % Hkv and Hq % Hv, line 695, and the kernel takes num_v_heads, line 1278) and the GPU reference grades it (TestGpuFpReferenceSdpa.cpp, GqaDifferentKvHeads): declined_or_pass. gqa_ratio: 12 to 40 query heads per K/V head (the supported space draws up to 8): declined_or_pass. DTYPES: dt_q_other, dt_k_other, dt_v_other, dt_o_other (one of Q, K, V, O in the other 16-bit type), dt_o_float (float O): line 709 asks K, V and O in Q's dtype: `declined`. dt_all_float: all four fp32; supportedDataTypeName (385-396) knows BF16 and FP16 only (no fp32 object in the catalog), but a correct engine may add one: declined_or_pass. BIAS (attn_mask, additive): attn_mask_dtype_other (a bias in the other 16-bit type, neither FP32 nor Q's dtype, 566-580), attn_mask_key_bcast ([1, 1, Sq, 1]: the key axis must equal Sq_k, 549), attn_mask_rank2 ([Sq, Skv]: rank 4 only, 548; the frontend takes rank up to 4, SdpaFwdNode.hpp:163-171), attn_mask_head_half ([1, Hq/2, Sq, Skv]: a head extent that is neither 1 nor Hq, 554-562) and attn_mask_key_stride (a bias with a key stride Sq, not 1: 550): `declined`. attn_mask_row_stride (a Q-dtype bias [1, 1, Sq, Skv] with a row stride Skv + 1 to Skv + 16, so rows start at odd element offsets where the pad is odd, the mid-dword start the kernels handle, 172-175): declined_or_pass. align_bias_f32 (an FP32 bias declared at alignment 1 or 2) and align_bias_q (a Q-dtype bias declared at 1): biasFor needs the element size, 4 or 2, to divide the declared alignment (581-584): `declined`. SCALE: scale_tensor (a device-resident scale tensor: only a pass-by-value one can be a launch argument, 643-647), scale_neg (-0.125) and scale_zero (0.0: the kernels take log2(e) * scale and need it finite and above 0, 666-669): `declined`. scale_absent (neither attn_scale_value nor a scale tensor: scale 1.0, 621-626 and 793-797, and the references' convention): declined_or_pass. UNSUPPORTED FEATURES (attributes the kernels have no input for, the list at 769-792): seq_len_q, seq_len_kv, padding (padding_mask with both tensors), dropout_philox (probability 0.1 with seed and offset), dropout_mask (explicit mask and scale tensors), rng_dump (dropout plus an rng_dump output), paged_kv (page tables and max_seq_len_kv, one 64-row block with the seq_len tensors), block_mask, sink (a FLOAT sink [1, Hq, 1, 1], the one the frontend takes), descale_qkv (descale_q, descale_k, descale_v), fp8_softmax_scales (descale_s, scale_s, scale_o, amax_s, amax_o) and alibi (alibi_mask with top-left causal, the form the references take): all `declined`. STATS: stats_no_flag (a stats tensor with generate_stats unset: 756-759), stats_flag_false (the tensor with generate_stats false: 756), stats_flag_no_tensor (generate_stats true without a tensor: 737-740), stats_half (an LSE tensor in half: 744) and row_stats (stats with max and sum_exp outputs: 786): `declined`. stats_unpacked (an LSE with token-major strides [Sq*Hq, 1, Hq, 1] instead of the packed [Hq*Sq, Sq, 1, 1]: the matcher takes any well-formed [B, Hq, Sq, 1] FLOAT tensor, 743-747, and the kernels take the three LSE strides, 1651-1653): declined_or_pass. align_stats (an LSE declared at alignment 1 or 2, LSE_ALIGN_BYTES 4: 751-754): `declined`. MASKS: bottom_right_sq_gt_skv (bottom-right causal with Skv = Sq/2, so the first rows see no key: the references give such a row zero output and an LSE of -inf, and the kernel is not described to define it; the supported space excludes them: a WRONG here is the finding) and window_no_keys (top-left left_bound 8, Skv = Sq/2: the rows past Skv + 7 see no key): declined_or_pass. window_right_only (right_bound 16, no left bound, top-left: maskFor builds a WINDOW, 450) and window_left_i32 (left_bound 2**31, a window wider than any key range, which maskFor refuses as it does not fit int32, 427-430): declined_or_pass, the second a gap a correct engine may close by clamping. Not drawn, and why: left_bound 0 and bounds below -1 (the frontend rejects them, SdpaFwdNode.hpp:40-42, SEM-005, so maskFor's refusal at 427 is not reachable from a valid graph), both deprecated causal flags (the references throw, PlanUtils.hpp:67-73), a scale tensor together with attn_scale_value (the frontend rejects it, SdpaFwdNode.hpp:202-207), a head count that does not divide Hq (SdpaFwdNode.hpp:137-152), a non-FLOAT sink (validateSinkToken), dropout_probability 0.0 alone (the engine accepts it, 774-775, and the references decline any dropout_probability, PlanUtils.hpp:361, so an accept could only be UNEXERCISED), a pass-by-value scale tensor (the engine serves it at launch, 643-663, and the harness supplies no runtime value) and ragged Q (the references need their ragged plan). STRIDES AND ALIGNMENT: q_row_stride_odd and o_row_stride_odd (the token stride of Q or O is Hq * head size + 4 elements, not a multiple of 8: hasAlignedRows, 355-365 and 714-720) and q_head_stride_nonunit (Q with every stride doubled, so the head-dim stride is 2: isWellFormedOperand, 319-322): `declined`. align_q, align_k, align_v, align_o (the tensor declared at 1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes, below the 16-byte vector access: QKVO_ALIGN_BYTES, 177 and 721-730; the declaration is a multiple guarantee, DeclaredAlignment.hpp): `declined`. HINTS: implementation_composite and implementation_unified (the matcher takes only AUTO, 789, an execution-strategy hint a fused kernel can honour), mma_float (mma_core_mode float: the kernels accumulate in FP32, accepted 798-806) and mma_fp8 (fp8_e4m3, outside the allow-list 800-806, a hint the 16-bit WMMA kernels could also honour): declined_or_pass. OVERFLOW: alt field 14 names one limit pushed past its bound at enforcement_level buildable (no tensor is allocated, filled or executed); strides are the exact dense BSHD strides of the huge dims, and every tuple keeps batch * Hq * ceil(Sq/128) at 16 or more, so it is prefill-routed. addressFitsI32 (367-383) asks the span of each of Q, K, V and O at 2 bytes an element (and of the bias at its element size) to be below 2**31 bytes, and every stride of a well-formed operand to fit int32 (314), so a tensor of 2**30 elements is the first refused while its strides still fit: kv_seq (Skv = 2**23, 128 wide: K and V), q_batch (batch 2**17, Skv 32: Q and O of 2**31 elements), q_wide, v_wide and o_wide (one tensor alone at 2**30 elements through a 256-wide head and a 2**18 or 2**22 length, the other side 8 wide, so Q, V or O is the one tensor that overflows), bias_span (a Q-dtype bias of 2**15 x 2**15 = 2**30 elements, the rest small: 585), sq_u32 (Sq = 2**32: not int32, 694-695) and skv_i64 (batch 2**20 and Skv 2**40: the stride and the element product overflow int64, 343-347). `expect` is `declined`; an accepted and built overflow case is reported UNEXERCISED with the reason `accepted above the oracle ceiling`. The space is probe-only and never frozen into a bundle.

derive.heads: [alt[9][1], alt[9][2]] if few else ([16, 2] if long_kv else (alt[11] if family == 'gqa_ratio' else [shape[2], shape[3]]))
derive.b_e: alt[14][1] if ov else (alt[9][0] if few else (1 if long_kv else shape[1]))
derive.sq_e: alt[14][4] if ov else (alt[0] if family == 'odd_sq' else (alt[8] if family == 'decode_small_sq' else (alt[9][3] if few else (alt[10][0] if fall_on else (64 if long_kv else shape[4])))))
derive.skv_e: alt[14][5] if ov else (alt[1] if family == 'odd_skv' else (64 if family == 'paged_kv' else (4096 if long_kv else (max(shape[4] // 2, 1) if family in ['bottom_right_sq_gt_skv', 'window_no_keys'] else shape[5]))))
derive.dqk: alt[14][6] if ov else (alt[2] if family == 'head_not_vector' else (alt[3] if family == 'head_unshipped' else (alt[4] if family == 'head_over_max' else (alt[10][1] if fall_on else (alt[7][0] if family == 'v_head_unshipped' else shape[6])))))
derive.dv_e: alt[14][7] if ov else (dqk if family in ['head_not_vector', 'head_unshipped', 'head_over_max'] else (alt[5] if family == 'v_head_not_vector' else (alt[6] if family == 'v_head_over_max' else (alt[7][1] if family == 'v_head_unshipped' else (alt[10][2] if fall_on else shape[7])))))
derive.hv: (hq if hkv != hq else 1) if family == 'kv_heads_differ' else hkv
derive.stride_q: [2 * sq_e * hq * dqk, 2 * dqk, 2 * hq * dqk, 2] if family == 'q_head_stride_nonunit' else [sq_e * rs_q, dqk, rs_q, 1]
derive.dtq: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_q_other' else dtype)
derive.dtk: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_k_other' else dtype)
derive.dtv: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_v_other' else dtype)
derive.dto: 'float' if family in ['dt_all_float', 'dt_o_float'] else (other if family == 'dt_o_other' else dtype)
derive.scale_value: None if family in ['scale_tensor', 'scale_absent'] else (-0.125 if family == 'scale_neg' else (0.0 if family == 'scale_zero' else 0.0883883461356163))
derive.left_b: 8 if family == 'window_no_keys' else (2147483648 if family == 'window_left_i32' else 256)
derive.right: 0 if family in ['alibi', 'bottom_right_sq_gt_skv', 'decode_causal_long_kv', 'decode_window_long_kv'] else (16 if family == 'window_right_only' else None)
derive.dtb: other if family == 'attn_mask_dtype_other' else ('float' if family == 'align_bias_f32' else dtype)
derive.dims_bias: [1, 1, sq_e, 1] if family == 'attn_mask_key_bcast' else ([sq_e, skv_e] if family == 'attn_mask_rank2' else ([1, hq // 2, sq_e, skv_e] if family == 'attn_mask_head_half' else [1, 1, sq_e, skv_e]))
derive.stride_bias: [sq_e, sq_e, 1, 1] if family == 'attn_mask_key_bcast' else ([skv_e, 1] if family == 'attn_mask_rank2' else ([(hq // 2) * sq_e * skv_e, sq_e * skv_e, skv_e, 1] if family == 'attn_mask_head_half' else ([sq_e * skv_e, sq_e * skv_e, 1, sq_e] if family == 'attn_mask_key_stride' else ([sq_e * (skv_e + alt[12]), sq_e * (skv_e + alt[12]), skv_e + alt[12], 1] if family == 'attn_mask_row_stride' else [sq_e * skv_e, sq_e * skv_e, skv_e, 1]))))
derive.al_bias: alt[13][2] if family == 'align_bias_f32' else (alt[13][3] if family == 'align_bias_q' else 16)
derive.stride_stats: [sq_e * hq, 1, hq, 1] if family == 'stats_unpacked' else [hq * sq_e, sq_e, 1, 1]
